g.text: Eight development videos; T = 8 temporal groups. Markers/bars: video medians; whiskers: observed minimum–maximum (not confidence intervals).
Panels A/C use the fixed post-FFN residual branch; C summarizes paired video ratios. Q/K heads are averaged at their actual head counts.
Hidden sampling: 0.214–0.294 Hz; Nyquist: 0.107–0.147 Hz. Sparse frames, no temporal antialias filter; no continuous-motion frequency claim.
